title: Explain review workflow to users
summary: An unfamiliar reviewer can understand and use the local semantic review workflow, while future Git topology options remain visible.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The roadmap identifies branch-per-stage stacked diffs as a potential future improvement without changing the current v0.1 model.
The manual explains how to start and open the local review app.
The manual explains stages, requirements, reasoning, validation, and diffs in user terms.
The manual explains how to create, submit, and review feedback across stages.
The manual explains resolution approval and whole-stack approval.
